item.text:
### (a) Social posts

1. We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, humanity will permanently lose control of its future. We refuse to treat that outcome as the price of progress.

2. We cannot build something smarter than humanity, surrender control to it, and expect to remain in charge. If we build superintelligent AI within the next 20 years, we will permanently lose control of our future. We must stop that race.

3. We stand for a future humanity still has the power to choose. Building superintelligent AI within the next 20 years will end that power permanently. We demand limits that keep our future in human hands.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We face a choice that will determine whether humanity remains in control of its future. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, we will lose that control permanently. We cannot accept an irreversible surrender of human agency as the cost of technological progress. We want science and technology to serve humanity, not replace us as the authors of our collective future. That means we must stop the race to build superintelligence, demand enforceable limits, and reject the idea that whatever can be built must be built. We have a responsibility to defend our power to choose—and to preserve that power for the generations that follow.
